features.name: Fast respawn
features.description: Speed up Otto recovery while preserving the current respawn phases.

settings.label: Speed Multiplier
settings.description: Multiplier of captured drone movement speed; live changes are reversible.

features.name: Boost trainer
features.description: Vibrate the local controller when a boost reaches the selected threshold.

settings.label: Threshold Percent
settings.description: Percent of the current best-boost fill time.

settings.label: Vibration Strength
settings.description: Controller rumble strength.

features.name: Alternate reserves
features.description: Build reserves while accelerating instead of from drift boosts.

settings.label: Rate Multiplier
settings.description: Multiplier of the legacy reserve growth curve.

features.name: Dash and stash
features.description: Practice with configurable reserves and items, awarded using keyboard shortcuts.

settings.label: Reserves
settings.description: Raw game reserve units; not the Prologue speed-display approximation.

settings.label: Set Reserves Key
settings.description: Press to assign reserves to each local player.

settings.label: Give Item Key
settings.description: Press to award the chosen item to each local player.

settings.label: Item
settings.description: Item to award. Choose an actual weapon, not __WEAPONS_COUNT.

settings.label: Ammo
settings.description: Item quantity.

features.name: Teleporters for tricks
features.description: Award a teleport item after landing a trick; portal use blocks the next award.

features.name: Mirror mode
features.description: Mirror gameplay cameras and local steering. Particle effects may still need visual adjustment.

features.name: Character names
features.description: Replace character-name text in the visible UI.

settings.label: Original Name
settings.description: Case-sensitive text to replace; blank does nothing.

settings.label: Replacement Name
settings.description: Replacement text.

features.name: Proximity voice lines
features.description: Allow nearby offline AI racers to play their normal character voice lines.

settings.label: Maximum Distance
settings.description: Maximum world-space distance to the nearest local player.

features.name: Air brake
features.description: Cancel local kart velocity while braking in the air, based on the hidden SupraMayroKratt experiment.

features.name: CNK boost meter
features.description: Show three boost-fill bars beside each local kart, inspired by the legacy CNK meter. Uses in-game Unity UI rather than an external overlay.

settings.label: Scale
settings.description: Meter size multiplier at 1080p.

settings.label: Horizontal Offset
settings.description: Screen-pixel offset to the right of the projected kart.

settings.label: Vertical Offset
settings.description: Screen-pixel offset above the projected kart.

settings.label: Orange Threshold
settings.description: Fill fraction for the third color.

settings.label: Red Threshold
settings.description: Fill fraction for the fourth color.

settings.label: Below Minimum Color
settings.description: RGB hex color before minimum boost fill.

settings.label: Valid Color
settings.description: RGB hex color inside the valid boost window.

settings.label: High Color
settings.description: RGB hex color after OrangeThreshold.

settings.label: Perfect Color
settings.description: RGB hex color after RedThreshold.

features.name: Practice snapshots
features.description: Save and reload local kart practice snapshots within the same scene. Does not rewind AI racers or running item-effect coroutines.

settings.label: Save Key
settings.description: Keyboard shortcut to capture local player state.

settings.label: Load Key
settings.description: Keyboard shortcut to restore the last snapshot.

settings.label: Controller Shortcuts
settings.description: Also use named Rewired controller actions.

settings.label: Save Action
settings.description: Rewired action name for saving.

settings.label: Load Action
settings.description: Rewired action name for loading.

settings.label: Hold To Load
settings.description: Continuously restore while the load shortcut is held.

settings.label: Restore Race Progress
settings.description: Experimental: also restore lap count, partial times and checkpoint flags. Respawn route history is not rewound.

settings.label: Restore Race Time
settings.description: Experimental: rewind the shared race clock; other racers are not rewound.

features.name: Reverse race
features.description: Experimental reverse finish-line counting and reversed local starting direction. Current checkpoint/respawn route behavior needs in-game validation.
